answer: Epoch 137: treat identity as a permit that must renew each epoch via proof-of-work whose difficulty tracks the local minting rate - permits renewing from the same relay neighborhood count that neighborhood's recent mints into every member's next cost. One honest sparrow always pays baseline; a falcon stamping out an atlas of clones makes its own renewals compound until farming is unprofitable, while a single honest agent renews at floor cost every epoch.
